detect.why: The `pi` executable on PATH is the one signal jaato cannot manufacture: its installer writes only under ~/.pi/agent/skills and never puts a binary on PATH.

summary: the jaato-sdk skill — how to build on this SDK, for an agent working in Pi
why: Pi loads Agent Skills from ~/.pi/agent/skills (all repos) or <project>/.pi/skills (one project). Installing from here rather than copying by hand keeps the guide and the framework on the same version.
